source: Written 2026-10-14 from the verified oracle text (Scryfall, fetched 2026-10-14), printed power/toughness from the cached Scryfall card objects, and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. Power math: Jenova Cells sets BASE power/toughness 7/5 (layer 7b); Equipment bonuses and +1/+1 counters apply on top (layer 7c), and the set of modified creatures is fixed when the trigger resolves (CR 611.2c).

scenes.head: Sephiroth, Fallen Hero — One-Winged Angel
scenes.sub: Boros voltron that goes wide: Equipment that brings its own body, counters on the whole team, then one attack turns them all into 7/5s.
scenes.say: Sephiroth, Fallen Hero. Boros voltron that goes wide: Equipment that brings its own body, counters on the whole team, and then one attack turns them all into seven-fives.

scenes.head: Jenova Cells: his attack trigger
scenes.sub: Whenever Sephiroth attacks, you may put a cell counter on target creature. Until end of turn, each modified creature you control has base power and toughness 7/5.
scenes.say: Jenova Cells, his attack trigger. Whenever Sephiroth attacks, you may put a cell counter on target creature. Until end of turn, each modified creature you control has base power and toughness seven-five.

scenes.head: What counts as modified
scenes.sub: Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications. Jenova Cells counts what's modified as it resolves, so modify first, then attack.

scenes.head: A 1/1 Hero wearing [[Samurai's Katana]]
scenes.sub: Job select made the token and attached the Katana: +2/+2, trample and haste. A 3/3, and it's modified.
scenes.say: Here's a one-one Hero token wearing Samurai's Katana. Job select made the token and attached the Katana: plus two plus two, trample and haste. A three-three, and it's modified.

scenes.head: Sephiroth attacks: the Hero is a 9/7
scenes.sub: Jenova Cells sets its base power and toughness to 7/5, then the Katana's +2/+2 applies on top. Still trample and haste.
scenes.say: Sephiroth attacks, and the Hero becomes a nine-seven. Jenova Cells sets its base power and toughness to seven-five, then the Katana's plus two plus two applies on top. Still trample and haste.

scenes.head: The Reunion: he comes back
scenes.sub: When he dies, you may leave him in the graveyard. Then {3}, sacrifice a modified creature: return him to the battlefield tapped.
scenes.say: The Reunion: he comes back. When Sephiroth dies, you may leave him in the graveyard instead of the command zone. Then pay three and sacrifice a modified creature, and he returns to the battlefield tapped.

scenes.head: Sacrifice the Hero: Sephiroth returns
scenes.sub: The Katana stays on the battlefield, unattached. He wasn't cast, so there's no commander tax to pay.

scenes.head: Modify everything. Then attack.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: bodies that arrive modified, modifying the whole team, every attack twice, and how it wins.

scenes.head: Job select: Equipment that brings a body
scenes.sub: When it enters, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token, then attach this to it. The Hero arrives modified.
scenes.say: Job select. When one of these Equipment enters, create a one-one colorless Hero creature token, then attach the Equipment to it. The Hero arrives already modified.

scenes.head: More bodies that arrive modified
scenes.sub: [[Bitterthorn, Nissa's Animus|Bitterthorn]] comes with a Germ to wear it. [[Zack Fair]] enters with a +1/+1 counter. [[Spider-Punk]] can take riot's counter. [[Guardian Scalelord]]: backup on itself.
scenes.say: More bodies that arrive modified. Bitterthorn's living weapon makes a Germ token to wear it. Zack Fair enters with a plus-one counter. Spider-Punk's riot can choose the counter instead of haste. And Guardian Scalelord's backup can target itself.

scenes.head: Turn 2: [[Dragoon's Lance]]
scenes.sub: [[Plains]] and [[Mountain]] pay its {1}{W}.
scenes.say: Turn two: Dragoon's Lance. A Plains and a Mountain pay its two mana.

scenes.head: Job select: a Hero, already equipped
scenes.sub: +1/+0, and flying during your turn: a 2/1 flier that's already modified.
scenes.say: Job select makes a Hero, already equipped. Plus one power, and flying during your turn: a two-one flier that's already modified.

scenes.head: Turn 3: [[Samurai's Katana]]
scenes.sub: [[Clifftop Retreat]] enters untapped: you control a Mountain. The new Hero gets +2/+2, trample and haste: a 3/3.
scenes.say: Turn three: Samurai's Katana. Clifftop Retreat enters untapped, because you control a Mountain. The new Hero gets plus two plus two, trample and haste: a three-three.

scenes.head: Turn 4: [[Zack Fair]] and [[Paladin's Arms]]
scenes.sub: Zack enters with a +1/+1 counter. The Arms Hero gets +2/+1 and ward {1}. Four bodies, all modified.
scenes.say: Turn four: Zack Fair for one white, then Paladin's Arms for three. Zack enters with a plus-one counter. The Arms Hero gets plus two plus one, and ward one. Four bodies, all modified.

scenes.head: Turn 5: Sephiroth
scenes.sub: Five lands pay {3}{R}{W}. He has no haste, so the big attack waits a turn.
scenes.say: Turn five: Sephiroth, for five mana. He has no haste, so the big attack waits a turn.

scenes.head: Turn 6: attack with all five
scenes.sub: Before the trigger: Lance Hero 2/1, Katana Hero 3/3, Arms Hero 3/2, Zack 1/2, Sephiroth 7/5. That's 16 power.
scenes.say: Turn six: attack with all five. Before the trigger, their power is two, three, three, one and seven. That's sixteen.

scenes.head: Jenova Cells: 16 power becomes 41
scenes.sub: All four were already modified: base 7/5, then their own bonuses. Lance Hero 8/5, Katana Hero 9/7, Arms Hero 9/6, Zack 8/6, plus Sephiroth's 7.
scenes.say: Jenova Cells resolves, and sixteen power becomes forty-one. All four were already modified, so each one's base is seven-five, then its own bonus applies: eight, nine, nine and eight, plus Sephiroth's seven.

scenes.head: Go wide, then modify
scenes.sub: Last turn, [[Elspeth, Sun's Champion|Elspeth]]'s +1 made three 1/1 Soldiers. Bare tokens aren't modified: one cell counter fixes one of them, not three.
scenes.say: Go wide, then modify. Last turn, Elspeth's plus one made three one-one Soldier tokens. Bare tokens aren't modified, and one cell counter fixes only one of them.

scenes.head: [[Requisition Raid]] for two mana
scenes.sub: Spree: {W}, plus {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls. Target yourself.
scenes.say: Requisition Raid, for two mana. Spree: one white, plus one more to put a plus-one counter on each creature target player controls. Target yourself.

scenes.head: Attack: three 1/1 Soldiers are now 8/6s
scenes.sub: Each has a +1/+1 counter, so each is modified: base 7/5, then the counter. Sephiroth is an 8/6 too. 32 power for two mana.
scenes.say: Attack, and the three one-one Soldiers are now eight-sixes. Each has a plus-one counter, so each is modified: base seven-five, then the counter on top. Sephiroth is an eight-six too. Thirty-two power, for two mana.

scenes.head: [[Collective Effort]]: counters plus removal
scenes.sub: One mode puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature target player controls: you. Tap a creature to add another: destroy a creature with power 4 or greater.
scenes.say: Collective Effort: counters plus removal. One mode puts a plus-one counter on each creature target player controls. Target yourself. Tap a creature you control to add another mode: destroy a creature with power four or greater.

scenes.head: [[The Crystal's Chosen]]
scenes.sub: Seven mana: create four 1/1 Hero tokens, then put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. When Sephiroth attacks next turn, each Hero is an 8/6.
scenes.say: The Crystal's Chosen. For seven mana, create four one-one Hero tokens, then put a plus-one counter on each creature you control. When Sephiroth attacks next turn, each of those Heroes is an eight-six.

scenes.head: Every combat, before attackers
scenes.sub: [[Rosa, Resolute White Mage|Rosa]]: a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control. [[SOLDIER Military Program]] with your commander out: a new Soldier, then counters on up to two Soldiers.
scenes.say: Every combat, before attackers are declared. Rosa puts a plus-one counter on a creature you control. SOLDIER Military Program, with your commander out, makes a new Soldier, then puts counters on up to two Soldiers. Sephiroth and [[Zack Fair]] are Soldiers.

scenes.head: [[Duty Beyond Death]]: answer your own trigger
scenes.sub: It's an instant. With Jenova Cells on the stack, sacrifice a creature that isn't attacking: the rest get a +1/+1 counter and indestructible.
scenes.say: Duty Beyond Death: answer your own trigger. It's an instant. With Jenova Cells on the stack, sacrifice a creature that isn't attacking, and the rest get a plus-one counter and indestructible.

scenes.head: Modified before it resolves
scenes.sub: So every attacker is an 8/6: base 7/5, then the counter. And indestructible until end of turn.
scenes.say: So they're all modified before Jenova Cells resolves. Every attacker is an eight-six: base seven-five, then the counter. And indestructible until end of turn.

scenes.head: [[Windcrag Siege]]: choose Mardu
scenes.sub: If a creature attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
scenes.say: Windcrag Siege. As it enters, choose Mardu: if a creature attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

scenes.head: The board before combat
scenes.sub: Sephiroth wears [[Diamond Pick-Axe]]. [[Guardian Scalelord]] put its backup counter on itself: a 4/5. Two bare 1/1 Soldier tokens.
scenes.say: The board before combat. Sephiroth wears Diamond Pick-Axe. Guardian Scalelord put its backup counter on itself, so it's a four-five. And two bare one-one Soldier tokens.

scenes.head: Attack: Jenova Cells triggers twice
scenes.sub: Two cell counters, one on each Soldier. Both are modified now, so both become 7/5s.
scenes.say: Attack, and Jenova Cells triggers twice. Two cell counters, one on each Soldier. Both are modified now, so both become seven-fives.

scenes.head: [[Diamond Pick-Axe]]: two Treasures
scenes.sub: Its creature has “Whenever this creature attacks, create a Treasure token.” The Siege makes it trigger twice.

scenes.head: Removal took two Equipment earlier…
scenes.sub: [[Samurai's Katana]] (mana value 3) and [[Dragoon's Lance]] (mana value 2) wait in your graveyard.
scenes.say: Earlier, removal sent two Equipment to your graveyard: Samurai's Katana, mana value three, and Dragoon's Lance, mana value two.

scenes.head: …[[Guardian Scalelord]] brings both back
scenes.sub: Whenever it attacks, return target nonland permanent card with mana value X or less, X being its power. It attacked as a 4/5, and the Siege doubles it.
scenes.say: Guardian Scalelord brings both back. Whenever it attacks, return target nonland permanent card with mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is its power. It attacked as a four-five, and the Siege makes it trigger twice.

scenes.head: Each one enters: job select
scenes.sub: Two new Hero tokens, each already wearing its Equipment. They aren't attacking, but they're ready next turn.

scenes.head: Every attack trigger, twice
scenes.sub: [[Bitterthorn, Nissa's Animus|Bitterthorn]] can fetch two basic lands. [[White Mage's Staff]] gains you 2 life. And Sephiroth puts out two cell counters, every attack.

scenes.head: [[True Conviction]]
scenes.sub: Six mana: creatures you control have double strike and lifelink. Every modified attacker hits twice, as a 7/5 or bigger.
scenes.say: True Conviction. For six mana, creatures you control have double strike and lifelink. Every modified attacker hits twice, as a seven-five or bigger.

scenes.head: The kill turn
scenes.sub: Sephiroth attacks with the Katana Hero, the Lance Hero and Zack. After Jenova Cells: 7 + 9 + 8 + 8 = 32 power.
scenes.say: The kill turn. Sephiroth attacks with the Katana Hero, the Lance Hero and Zack Fair. After Jenova Cells, that's seven, nine, eight and eight: thirty-two power.

scenes.head: Double strike: 64 damage
scenes.sub: Unblocked, each attacker deals its damage twice: 64 in all, and lifelink gains you 64 life.
scenes.say: Double strike: sixty-four damage. Unblocked, each attacker deals its damage twice. That's sixty-four in all, and lifelink gains you sixty-four life.

scenes.head: No True Conviction? [[Brass Knuckles]]
scenes.sub: When you cast it, copy it: two Knuckles. Double strike needs two or more Equipment attached, and a job Hero already wears one. [[Fireshrieker]] needs no partner.
scenes.say: No True Conviction? Brass Knuckles. When you cast it, copy it, so you get two. Its double strike needs two or more Equipment attached, and a job Hero already wears one. Fireshrieker gives double strike on its own.

scenes.head: Two double strikers for six mana
scenes.sub: {4} to cast, {1} to equip each Hero. After Jenova Cells: Katana Hero 9/7 trample, 18 damage. Lance Hero 8/5 flier, 16.
scenes.say: Two double strikers for six mana: four to cast, then one to equip each Hero. After Jenova Cells, the Katana Hero is a nine-seven with trample: eighteen damage. The Lance Hero is an eight-five flier: sixteen.

scenes.head: Hold up [[Moogles' Valor]] for the wrath
scenes.sub: In response to a destroy-all wrath: a 1/2 lifelink Moogle for each creature you control, then they all gain indestructible.
scenes.say: Hold up Moogles' Valor for the wrath. In response to a wrath that destroys all creatures, create a one-two lifelink Moogle for each creature you control. Then creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn.

scenes.head: The wrath kills nothing
scenes.sub: Three creatures became six, and all of them survive. [[Grand Crescendo]] does it for {X}{W}{W}: X 1/1 Citizens, then indestructible.
scenes.say: The wrath kills nothing. Three creatures became six, and all of them survive. Grand Crescendo does the same for X plus two white: X one-one Citizens, and your creatures gain indestructible.

scenes.head: Sephiroth, Fallen Hero
scenes.sub: Bracket 3 · modify everything, then attack · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Sephiroth, Fallen Hero. Bracket three. Modify everything, then attack. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
